raw_answer_text:
Looking at the validation errors, I can see two main issues:

1. **"block" keyword is not allowed** — In FigDown's block genre, nodes should be declared without the `block` keyword; just the id and label
2. **Edge operators are missing** — Each edge needs a directional operator like `->`, `<-`, `--`, or `<->`

Since this describes a workflow where the scheduler triggers the job, the job orchestrates to CA and Deploy Agent, etc., the direction should flow from trigger/caller to recipient. I'll use `->` to show this flow.

```figdown
# FigDown — figures as text. Spec: https://github.com/FigDown/figdown
figdown 0.1 block
title "Certificate renewal automation"

scheduler "Scheduler"
renewaljob "Renewal Job"
caclient "CA Client"
ca "Certificate Authority"
deployagent "Deploy Agent"
service "Service"

scheduler -> renewaljob
renewaljob -> caclient
caclient -> ca
renewaljob -> deployagent
deployagent -> service
```

The corrected document removes the `block` keyword from node declarations and adds the `->` operator to each edge, showing the direction of control/data flow through the certificate renewal automation workflow.
